description.value: Recall Knowledge checks about pre-Turning history, technology, or culture automatically succeed at trained-level difficulty.

cinderfall.incomplete: Recall-Knowledge-about-a-specific-lore-topic bonuses have no predicate hook -- confirmed via liminal-catfolk.json's real but trait-scoped precedent; a free-text lore topic like this one can't be targeted. There is no rule-element that guarantees an outright success or converts a failed save/check to a success after the fact; AdjustDegreeOfSuccess only shifts the degree of an actual roll.
